title: docs: simplify coding harness guide
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Explains the shared `polli harness` lifecycle first
- Marks DeepSeek Harness as the only currently available profile
- Lists planned harnesses and only their unique integration details

Test: `npx vitest run test/docs.test.ts` from `gen.pollinations.ai`

gist.headline: One harness, clearer trails
gist.blurb: The coding harness guide now starts with the shared `polli harness` lifecycle, rather than making every future tool explain the same garden path. DeepSeek Harness is marked as the profile currently ready to use.
gist.summary: Simplified `CODING_HARNESSES.md` by documenting the shared `polli harness` lifecycle first, identifying DeepSeek Harness as the only available profile, and separating planned harnesses into their integration-specific details.
gist.impact: Developers can now see the common harness workflow immediately, know that DeepSeek is available today, and find future integration notes without rereading shared setup steps.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a cozy trail guide in a code-garden, pointing from one clearly labeled shared `polli harness` path toward a ready DeepSeek terminal, while small signposts for future harnesses branch off with only their unique tools. The scene represents removing duplicated directions and making the currently usable route obvious.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush and light blue wings, wearing a tiny explorer scarf and pointing at a clear garden trail sign reading `polli harness`; a retro terminal labeled `DeepSeek` glows beside her while small flower-lined paths lead toward future tool sheds. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, code-plants and vines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
